relocation_line: I will relocate to Brisbane for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi vTCE team,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'm after a start as a junior civil designer. Your careers page says you're always on the lookout for people, from cadets up to senior level, so I thought I'd get in touch.

In the course I designed roads, earthworks and stormwater drainage, and drew them up in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. Before that I worked on building sites in the Philippines, reviewing the drawings and doing site inspections and quality checks.

I can move to Brisbane and start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to have a chat whenever suits.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
